Aananthy Manoharan
Senior Solution Architect | DevOps & Cloud Expert
📧 aananthy86@gmail.com | 📱 +91-9884682666
📍 Chennai, India
🔗 LinkedIn: aananthy-manoharan

Professional Summary

Seasoned Azure Cloud Architect with 18 years of IT experience and 5+ years of leadership in cloud infrastructure, automation, and DevOps engineering. Demonstrated excellence in architecting and delivering scalable, secure, and high-availability solutions using Azure native services and automation frameworks.

Proficient in designing enterprise architectures such as microservices, service-oriented architecture (SOA), and 3-tier web applications on Azure IaaS and PaaS. Specialized in Infrastructure as Code (IaC), CI/CD pipeline design, Kubernetes orchestration, hybrid networking, and cloud security.

A proven strategic thinker and innovation leader, capable of aligning cloud adoption and modernization initiatives with organizational goals. Brings strong communication skills to articulate technical vision to stakeholders and facilitate collaboration across diverse teams. Skilled in client engagement, ensuring business needs are translated into secure, cost-effective, and scalable solutions. Known for setting the technical direction, mentoring junior engineers, and driving continuous improvement by integrating cutting-edge cloud technologies into enterprise frameworks.

Deep expertise in Azure infrastructure planning, subscription modeling, and multi-tenant governance. Experienced in environment provisioning for complex enterprise workloads including Dynamics 365, Azure AD identity integration, and hybrid connectivity. Adept at leading architecture workshops, guiding implementation teams, and ensuring alignment with security and compliance best practices.

Why I’m a Fit: My expertise in DevOps, architectural planning, and cloud modernization is transferable across cloud platforms. While Azure is my primary domain, my engineering approach and delivery methodology align with any enterprise cloud transformation initiative.

Technical Skills

Cloud Platforms: Azure (Expert – IaaS, PaaS, SaaS, Hybrid Environments), AWS (Basic), GCP (Limited Exposure), Mendix Private Cloud

Azure Identity & Security:

Azure Active Directory (B2B/B2C), Conditional Access Policies, MFA, SSPR

Azure Policy, Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), Privileged Identity Management (PIM)

Cloud Governance & Subscription Management:

Management Groups, Policy Assignments, Enterprise-Scale Landing Zones

Cost Management, Budgeting, Blueprints

Azure Integration Services: Logic Apps, API Management, Azure Service Bus, Event Grid, Web Jobs

Disaster Recovery & BCP: Azure Site Recovery, Geo-redundancy, Cross-region failover design

Architectural Patterns: Microservices Architecture, 3-tier Web Architecture, SOA, Event-Driven Architecture, API Gateway Integration
Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Terraform, ARM Templates, Bicep, Ansible
Networking: Azure Virtual Networks, VPNs, ExpressRoute, Load Balancers, DNS, App Gateway, Private Endpoints
Containerization: Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), Docker, Helm, OpenShift
Automation & Scripting: PowerShell, Azure CLI, Python, Bash
CI/CD & DevOps: Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Ansible, Terraform Pipelines
Security & Compliance: Azure Security Center, RBAC, Azure Policy, ISO27001, SOC2
Monitoring & Backup: Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Application Insights, Prometheus, Grafana, Azure Backup
Data & Storage: Azure SQL, Cosmos DB, PostgreSQL, DB2, Blob, File Shares
Cost Optimization: Azure Advisor, Cost Management, Rightsizing, Reserved Instances
Governance & Design: Architecture Assessment, Tradeoff Analysis, TCO/ROI Evaluation, NFR Solutioning, Compliance Evaluation

Documentation & Architecture Artifacts: Requirements Traceability Matrix (RTM), Detailed Design Docs, Security Architecture Plans

Professional Experience

Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) — 2019 to Present

Azure Architect | DevOps/Platform Architect | Cloud Strategy Consultant

Architected microservices-based solutions using AKS, Azure API Management, Azure Functions, and Service Bus.

Designed and implemented 3-tier application architectures across development and production Azure environments.

Delivered secure and scalable Azure IaaS/PaaS solutions, with resilient networking and high-availability patterns.

Built IaC-based deployments using Terraform, Bicep, and ARM templates across subscriptions and tenants.

Implemented CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps and GitHub Actions, including automated build, test, and release flows.

Migrated on-premises legacy applications to Azure, with re-architecture strategies for modernization.

Enabled DevSecOps practices, integrating security and compliance scans into pipelines.

Set up robust monitoring, alerting, and observability using Azure Monitor, Prometheus, and Grafana.

Led workshops with enterprise clients for cloud strategy, modernization roadmap, and solution blueprinting.

Provided architectural governance, reviewed HLD/LLDs, and conducted architecture assessments and design reviews.

Designed cloud infrastructure for hybrid and pure Azure deployments, including development, test, and production environments following Microsoft’s Cloud Adoption Framework.

Led subscription modeling across business units, configuring management groups, policies, and budget controls aligned to governance and enterprise access policies.

Architected secure Azure AD integrations, enabling SSO, MFA, and seamless identity lifecycle management across applications including Dynamics 365 F&O.

Delivered disaster recovery strategies using Azure Site Recovery and backup automation to ensure BCP readiness.

Defined and reviewed architecture artifacts like Requirements Traceability Matrices (RTM), Security Design Plans, and Technical Architecture Documents.

Integrated cloud-native services such as Logic Apps, APIM, Service Bus, Event Grid, and Web Jobs for seamless app communication and enterprise service orchestration.

Guided cross-functional teams on infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Bicep), Azure DevOps automation, and IaC deployment pipelines.

Advised clients on planning and migration strategies, security posture assessment, and optimization of hybrid workloads.

Led and mentored a cross-functional team of engineers and junior architects on IaC, DevSecOps, and architectural principles.

Spearheaded initiatives for continuous improvement by integrating new cloud-native tools and patterns.

Facilitated knowledge sharing through workshops, documentation, and solution accelerators.

Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) — 2007 to 2019

Developer, Tech Lead, DevOps Transformation Specialist

Enabled DevOps adoption across application teams by establishing CI/CD and IaC practices.

Collaborated with stakeholders to redesign applications from monolith to service-oriented and microservices models.

Delivered training and mentoring sessions to cross-functional teams on Agile DevOps and automation tools.

Certifications

Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305)

Microsoft Certified: Azure DevOps Engineer Expert (AZ-400)

Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate (AZ-104)

Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Engineer Associate (AI-102)

Microsoft Certified: Azure Data Engineer Associate (DP-203)

Microsoft Certified: Azure Data Scientist Associate (DP-100)

Professional Scrum Master I (PSM I)

Education

PG Diploma in AI & ML – University of Texas at Austin & Great Lakes (2020–2021)

Master of Computer Applications – SASTRA University (2008–2011)

Bachelor of Science in Mathematics & Physics – Madurai Kamaraj University (2003–2006)

Key Achievements

Reduced deployment time by 50% using Terraform-driven automation frameworks.

Delivered 30% cloud cost savings through optimization and governance policies.

Implemented multi-region AKS architecture with microservices for fault-tolerant systems.

Conducted trade-off analysis and architecture reviews to align with performance and scalability goals.

Led transformation programs for application modernization using SOA and event-driven design principles.

Defined strategic cloud transformation plans for multiple clients, aligning technical roadmaps with business objectives.

Presented technical proposals and architectural frameworks to executive leadership for approval and funding.

Championed client-centered architecture reviews, ensuring delivery was aligned to expectations and KPIs.

Mentored junior architects and DevOps engineers, enabling career progression and skill development.

Pioneered proof-of-concepts on emerging Azure services to support innovation and competitive differentiation.

Enabled organizational cloud maturity uplift by establishing reusable frameworks and governance templates.

Led the Azure infrastructure design for a multi-region enterprise rollout of Dynamics 365 with hybrid identity management and secure B2B access control.

Created technical designs and RTMs that streamlined review cycles by 40%, enhancing traceability and stakeholder confidence.

Devised backup and DR strategies for mission-critical systems, achieving RPO/RTO compliance for all identified workloads.

Delivered multi-layered security architecture using Azure AD, Conditional Access, and Azure Policy to meet ISO27001 compliance.
